## Changes

### Bug Fixes

- Silence expected LogTracer::init() warning caused by Tauri double-initialization

### Refactoring

- Extract logging initialization into dedicated module for cleaner code organization
- Slim lib.rs by moving utility functions to their proper modules

### Maintenance

- Replace single app.log with session-based log files (app-TIMESTAMP.log, max 20)
- Add session header with version, build mode, and platform info on startup
- Filter console output to warn+ only in debug builds (file logs still capture everything)
- Remove verbose terminal debug emit calls from terminal reader threads
- Downgrade GitHub API operational logs from info to debug level
- Clean up console.log debug noise from frontend components
